Package aor.proj3t.filters

Class EvaluationFilter

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.filters.EvaluationFilter
public class EvaluationFilter extends Object
Filter class for evaluation queries. This class encapsulates all possible filter criteria for searching and filtering evaluations in the system. It supports filtering by evaluation participants, status, dates, evaluation scales, and text search, as well as sorting options.

The filter supports both single date filtering and date range filtering. Date strings are automatically parsed and validated during the hydration process.

Example usage: 

 GET /api/evaluations?evaluatedId=123invalid input: '&status'=COMPLETEDinvalid input: '&startDate'=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z

    • hydrate

      public void hydrate()
      Parses and validates string date parameters into proper date objects.

      This method converts:

      • dateString (yyyy-MM-dd format) to LocalDate
      • startDate and endDate (ISO-8601 format) to DateRange with Instant values

      If only startDate is provided, endDate defaults to current time. If only endDate is provided, startDate defaults to 100 years ago.

      Throws:
      BadRequestException - if date parsing fails due to invalid format
